scope: Existing canonical Poaceae species only; POWO/WCVP accepted names, synonymy, rank, homonym and source concept; no card or nativity edits

critical_nonmatching_names.name: Paspalum setaceum var. pubiflorum Vasey
critical_nonmatching_names.powo_relation: homotypic synonym of separately accepted Paspalum palmeri Chase, NOT Paspalum pubiflorum Rupr. ex E.Fourn.

critical_nonmatching_names.name: Paspalum setaceum var. dispar R.Guzmán
critical_nonmatching_names.powo_relation: heterotypic synonym of separately accepted Paspalum ligulare Nees

critical_nonmatching_names.name: Paspalum setaceum Raspail
critical_nonmatching_names.powo_relation: illegitimate name, homotypic synonym of Microchloa indica (L.f.) P.Beauv.; different name authorship and taxon

taxa.action: Retain one P. setaceum Michx. species card; document accepted varieties and divergent historical names; do not automatically reassign photographs, species or varieties.

taxa.identity_boundary: Accepted P. pubiflorum Rupr. ex E.Fourn. is NOT P. setaceum var. pubiflorum Vasey, which Kew assigns to P. palmeri Chase. Do not merge similarly worded historical epithets without author and rank.
taxa.specimen_identity: HOLD_SOURCE_PHOTO_IDENTITY_PROVISIONAL; accepted nomenclature is not specimen verification
taxa.action: Preserve separate P. pubiflorum canonical species; no photo reassignment, no hybrid decision.

cross_taxon_guardrail: P. setaceum Michx. and P. pubiflorum Rupr. ex E.Fourn. remain separate accepted canonical species. P. setaceum var. pubiflorum Vasey belongs to P. palmeri Chase, not either learner card. Preserve source author, rank, original determinations and scientific holds.
hybrid_review: No hybrid determination established; no hybrid HOLD released.
preserve_scientific_states: All existing PASS/FAIL/HOLD/UNRESOLVED and original source/photo identification records unchanged; nomenclatural acceptance alone cannot clear an identification HOLD.
